title: Epic 1: Decompose `application_settings.rs` into Per-Domain Configuration Modules
summary: Epic plan to split the 3,172-line application_settings.rs into per-domain config modules under a config/ directory with a composing root Settings struct.
notes: MANIFEST_TYPE=DOC applied as authoritative. Content carries PRD-like signals (Objective, Acceptance Criteria, Tasks with deliverables and effort estimates) that would otherwise suggest PRD; manifest override retained.
